verdict.rationale: Scoped, least-privilege credentials are a fair question for a credential and authentication product. YubiKey also exposes a programmatic surface through the YubiEnterprise REST API and ykman. However, nothing in the evidence shows issuing scoped or least-privilege API tokens for an agent. The pack covers hardware-bound keys (PIV, FIDO2 SSH, OATH) and fleet-management APIs, but nothing about scoping credentials or delegating them to agents.
